name: HaterPicks API (HaterAPI)
description: The HaterPicks API returns live Australian sports-betting odds, merged and de-duplicated across Australian bookmakers. The Free plan covers game lines (head-to-head, totals and lines/spreads); Starter adds player props; Pro and Business add fair prices with edge %, arbitrage and same-game multi quotes. Plans: Free $0 AUD/month, 1,000 calls; Starter $29 AUD/month, 50,000 calls; Pro $79 AUD/month, 250,000 calls; Business $249 AUD/month, 1,000,000 calls. Every keyed response carries X-Quota-Limit, X-Quota-Remaining and X-Quota-Reset headers for the monthly allowance, and RateLimit-Policy / RateLimit (IETF draft) plus X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset for the per-minute limit; a 429 adds Retry-After. Versioning: the version is in the path (/api/v1) and v1 only ever adds fields, parameters and endpoints. A breaking change ships as /api/v2; the old version then sends Deprecation and Sunset headers and keeps answering for at least 6 months. Policy: https://www.haterpicks.app/api#versioning. Responses are gzipped when the client sends Accept-Encoding: gzip (use curl --compressed). HaterPicks is an analytics service, not a bookmaker: the API never places bets. Get a key at https://www.haterpicks.app/developer. Odds are decimal. Times are ISO 8601 UTC.
